$description: knobs design tokens: the single source of truth for the brand's colours, type, geometry and motion. Edit this file, then run `node tokens/build.mjs` to regenerate dist/. Colours are sRGB hex. Each colour carries its OKLCH, the space the palette is derived in, and where it has been measured, its WCAG 2 contrast ratio against the tokens named beside it in the same group. The build checks both against the hex values.

brand.$description: The brand's named colours. The logo files are drawn in graphite, ink, cap red, cap red deep, white and black.

graphite.$description: The brand ground: the dark scheme's page, the app icon's tile and the share card. The logo's ink on light grounds, and text in the light scheme.

ink.$description: The logo's ink on dark grounds, and text in the dark scheme.

cap-red.$description: The colour of knobs on dark grounds: the logo's sweep and "obs", the action colour, and everything that is knobs. Never on the ink, and the ink never on it (2.8:1).

cap-red-deep.$description: Cap red for white and light grounds, with white words on it, and the footer band in both schemes.

white.$description: Panels and rows in the light scheme, words on red, and the one-colour logo on colour, mid-tones and photos.

black.$description: The one-colour logo on light colours and photos.

neutral.$description: Cool neutrals on graphite's hue (260 in OKLCH), never warm and never cream. Each ramp is keyed by OKLCH lightness in thousandths.

scheme.$description: Colour by role, in the two schemes. Every role has a value in both. The dark scheme is the default; the light scheme is composed for daylight, not inverted.

dark.$description: Graphite grounds, ink text, cap red for what is knobs and what can be pressed.

ground.$description: The page. Sections alternate between it and ground-deep.

ground-deep.$description: A band a step below the ground, for the sections that alternate with it, deep enough to show on a dim screen.

raised.$description: A panel or a row on the ground.

raised-2.$description: A raised panel under the pointer, or a pressed control.

sunken.$description: A well: code, checksums, the filter chain.

screen.$description: The frame of a video or a screenshot: a well, like a screen that's off.

line.$description: Hairlines: rules, row dividers, wires, gridlines.

text-2.$description: Secondary text: the lede, notes, links in a list.

text-3.$description: Labels, captions and the legal lines, and idle icons and wires.

action.$description: Cap red as the action colour: solid buttons, outlined buttons' edges, the main file's edge, the download step.

action-hover.$description: A solid button under the pointer, lit a step.

action-text.$description: Red words: an outlined button's label, a hovered link, a recommended file's tag.

on-action.$description: Words and icons on a solid red button: graphite, never ink.

link-underline.$description: A link's underline. The words keep their own colour; the underline says it's a link.

link-hover.$description: A link's words under the pointer.

focus.$description: The focus ring, 2px wide and 2px outside the control.

selection.$description: Selected text's ground: a wash of cap red, under ink.

band.$description: The footer band, cap red deep in both schemes: the page's one large field of red, and a red the page already uses.

band-line-strong.$description: Control edges and titled rules on the band.

on-band.$description: Every word, link and underline on the band, and the white one-colour lockup. White on cap red deep is 4.5:1 with no margin, so small words take weight 500.

band-selection.$description: Selected text's ground on the band: a deeper red, under white.

band-focus.$description: The focus ring on the band.

chart-knobs.$description: knobs in a chart: its bars, lit in cap red.

chart-obs.$description: OBS in a chart: an unlit grey beside knobs's lit red. In dark it is apart from the red in lightness as well as hue.

light.$description: A cool pale grey desk with white panels, graphite text, cap red deep for what is knobs and what can be pressed. No button is graphite or black.

ground.$description: The page: a cool pale grey desk. Sections alternate between it and ground-deep.

ground-deep.$description: A band a step deeper than the ground, for the sections that alternate with it.

raised.$description: Panels and rows: white on the grey.

raised-2.$description: A white panel under the pointer, or a pressed control.

sunken.$description: A well: code, checksums, the filter chain.

screen.$description: The frame of a video or a screenshot: a white screen on the grey.

line.$description: Hairlines: rules, row dividers, wires, gridlines.

text-2.$description: Secondary text: the lede, notes, links in a list.

text-3.$description: Labels, captions and the legal lines, and idle icons and wires.

action.$description: Cap red deep as the action colour: solid buttons, outlined buttons' edges, the main file's edge, the download step.

action-hover.$description: A solid button under the pointer, pressed deeper.

action-text.$description: Red words, a step deeper than cap red deep so they keep 4.5:1 on every light ground.

on-action.$description: Words and icons on a solid red button: white.

link-underline.$description: A link's underline. The words keep their own colour; the underline says it's a link.

link-hover.$description: A link's words under the pointer.

focus.$description: The focus ring, 2px wide and 2px outside the control.

selection.$description: Selected text's ground: a wash of cap red, under graphite.

band.$description: The footer band: the same in both schemes.

band-line-strong.$description: Control edges and titled rules on the band.

on-band.$description: Every word, link and underline on the band, and the white one-colour lockup.

band-selection.$description: Selected text's ground on the band, under white.

band-focus.$description: The focus ring on the band.

chart-knobs.$description: knobs in a chart: its bars, lit in cap red deep.

chart-obs.$description: OBS in a chart: an unlit grey. In light it sits near knobs's red in lightness, so labels, order, printed values and knobs's weight carry the difference, never colour alone.

status.$description: The app's state marks: the tray icon's badges, and the marks beside a note in the setup window. The same in both schemes, apart from the info disc, which turns over on a dark ground. They belong to the product alone: never in brand material, and never a text colour, a border or a fill.

ok.$description: Set: a disc with a white check.

stop.$description: Needs you: a disc with a white exclamation mark.

warn.$description: A warning: a triangle with a dark exclamation mark.

info.$description: Paused, or a note, on a light ground: a disc with white pause bars or a white i.

info-on-dark.$description: Paused, or a note, on a dark ground: the info disc turned over, white, so it stands out from the ground as the graphite disc doesn't.

on-info-on-dark.$description: The pause bars or the i on the white info disc.

on-status.$description: The glyph on the ok, stop and info discs.

on-warn.$description: The glyph on the warning triangle.

status-shape.$description: The state marks' shapes, as SVG path data in a 16-unit box with absolute M, L, H, V, A and Z only. Each mark is a ground in its status colour with a glyph filled over it, never stroked, and cut like the logo: square ends, level and plumb edges, true circles. A mark is drawn at the size it's shown at, 16 units to its width.

disc.$description: The ground of the ok, stop and info marks and the pause badge: a true circle filling the box.

triangle.$description: The warning's ground: equilateral and 18 units across, past the box's sides, so it weighs as much as a disc to the eye.

check.$description: Set, on the ok disc: two arms 2 units wide at 45 degrees, meeting in a mitred corner, their ends cut square to them. It sits a little below the centre, where its weight balances.

exclamation.$description: Needs you, on the stop disc: a bar 2 units wide and 5.5 tall over a 2-unit square, 1.5 apart.

information.$description: A note, on the info disc: the exclamation mark turned over.

pause.$description: Paused, on the info disc: two bars 2 units wide and 7 tall, 1.5 apart.

triangle-exclamation.$description: A warning, on the triangle: the exclamation mark, 4.5 tall over its square, set low where the triangle is wide.

sans.$description: Every word: headings, body text, controls, numbers. Radio Canada Fallback is Arial scaled to Radio Canada's width and line metrics, declared by the page.

display.$description: Display only, at Bold 700: the one headline, the section titles, the closing title and the footer's column heads.

mono.$description: Anything a reader could copy or type: commands, paths, file names, versions in running text, checksums. Ligatures off.

bold.$description: Radio Canada Condensed only, for display.

size.$description: The type scale, as CSS lengths. Display and title are fluid; everything else is in rem, so it follows the reader's text size.

display.$description: The one headline, in the display face.

title.$description: Section titles, in the display face.

heading.$description: A row's or a measurement's title.

subheading.$description: A step's, a fact's or a question's heading.

md.$description: Controls and navigation: buttons, section links, the footer.

xs.$description: Labels, captions, code blocks and the legal lines.

lede.$description: The lede, notes and small text.

radius.$description: Every rectangle's corners: buttons, panels, wells, rows, tags, frames, focus rings. Round things are true circles.

hairline.$description: Every line: rules, borders, wires, gridlines.

focus-offset.$description: The gap between a control and its focus ring.

dot.$description: A cap dot at the default text size. It grows with the text and stays an odd number of pixels, so it centres on a 1px rule.

ease.$description: The one curve: quick to start, then settling. Things settle; nothing performs.

fast.$description: Feedback: a hover, a copy confirming, a disclosure opening.

slow.$description: Structure: a state settling, a panel changing height, a marker moving to a new place.

breath.$description: A waiting mark's breath: it fades out and back once in this time, for as long as something waits.

rise.$description: How far arriving content moves into place as it fades in, over the fast duration, rising from below or falling from above.
